title: Is Random Video Chat Safe? 10 Safety Tips for 2026
description: Random video chat can be fun, but it pays to be careful. Ten practical tips for protecting your privacy and handling bad behaviour.
h1: Is random video chat safe? 10 tips to protect yourself
intro: Talking to strangers over video can be a great way to meet people, but you are chatting with someone you know nothing about. Most conversations are harmless; a few are not. These habits keep you in control.

p: Treat a stranger like a stranger. Nobody you just met needs your full name, address, school, workplace, phone number or social media handle.
ul: Keep your location vague: a country or a big city is plenty.
Do not share photos, documents or anything with your name or address on it.
Check what is visible behind you on camera: mail, school badges, street views through a window.

sections.h: Do not move off the platform too fast
p: If someone quickly asks to continue on another app, ask yourself why. People who want to scam or pressure you often try to take the conversation somewhere with no moderation. If you do want to stay in touch, use the in-app friends and messaging features first.

sections.h: Never send money or gift cards
p: No genuine conversation with a stranger requires you to pay. Stories about emergencies, sick relatives, investments or giveaways are common scams. Say no and report the person.

sections.h: Know that you are always allowed to leave
p: You do not owe anyone a conversation. If something feels uncomfortable, press Next. You do not have to explain, and you never have to finish a call to be polite.

When someone breaks the rules, report them. On Wavely a report sends moderators a screenshot and the recent chat lines, and repeat offenders are banned, including by device. Arguing back or copying bad behaviour usually makes things worse.

sections.h: Expect that anything on camera can be recorded
p: Wavely does not store video, but another person can still record their own screen or phone. Do not do or show anything on a video call that you would not be comfortable seeing shared.

sections.h: Be careful with links and downloads
p: Do not click links or open files sent by someone you just met. They can lead to phishing pages or malware.
Use a private place, a device you control and a connection you trust. If you are on a shared computer, sign out afterwards.
Random video chat is for adults. Wavely is 18+ and bans minors. If you are a parent, device parental controls can block the site or app.
If a conversation feels off, it probably is. Leave, report if needed, and take a break. Most people you meet will be friendly, and you can afford to be picky.

title: Omegle Alternative: What to Look For in a Random Video Chat Site
description: Omegle shut down in November 2023. Here is what to look for in an alternative: safety, moderation, privacy and a simple way to meet people.
h1: Looking for an Omegle alternative? What to look for
intro: Omegle closed in November 2023 after years of criticism about safety. Plenty of sites have since appeared in its place, and they are not all equal. Here is how to tell a good random video chat site from a bad one.

p: Omegle's founder said the site could no longer be run safely and sustainably, after a long history of misuse and legal pressure. The lesson most people took away: a random chat service needs real moderation, not just a Next button.
A trustworthy site is for adults only and says so up front. Look for an 18+ confirmation, rules you must accept, and a policy that bans minors.

You should be able to report someone in one tap, and the site should tell you what happens next. Look for human moderators, automatic checks and bans that stick, for example by device, not just by account.

Find out whether video is stored. On Wavely, video goes through a secure media server and is not stored. Only when a report is made are a screenshot and the recent chat lines kept for moderators, and they are deleted after a retention period.
Good sites check for explicit video and hide it. On Wavely your device checks the stranger's video and blurs it if it looks explicit, and you decide whether to show it or press Next.

Random video chat should be simple: press Start, talk, press Next. No account is needed to try Wavely. An account lets you add friends, message them and call them again, which is the part that makes random chats turn into real connections.

Free access with sensible daily limits, plus an optional paid plan, is a sign the site has a business model other than selling your data. Be wary of sites that are completely free and cover costs with aggressive ads.

ul: No age rules, or an age check you can click through in a second.
No report button, or reports that nobody reads.
Pop-ups, fake download buttons and requests to install software.
Bots that push you to another website or app.
Vague or missing privacy and terms pages.

title: How to Start a Conversation on Random Video Chat
description: Nervous about the first ten seconds? Easy openers, questions that keep a chat going and how to leave politely.
h1: How to start a conversation on random video chat
intro: The first ten seconds decide whether a random chat goes anywhere. A friendly start, a good question and a calm way to move on make every call easier.

p: You do not need a clever line. A smile, a wave and a short hello is the strongest opening there is.
ul: “Hi! Where are you joining from?”
“Hey, how's your day going?”
“Hi, I'm new here. Any tips?”

p: Questions that need more than yes or no keep things moving.
ul: What is the best thing you ate this week?
What is something you are learning right now?
If you could be anywhere right now, where would it be?
What music, shows or games are you into lately?

sections.h: Be curious about where they are
p: One of the best parts of random video chat is meeting people from other countries. Ask about local food, holidays, the weather or what a normal weekend looks like. People enjoy explaining their home.
A good first impression is mostly lighting and sound.
ul: Put a light in front of you, not behind.
Raise the camera to eye level.
Use headphones to avoid echo.
Pick a quiet, tidy place.

p: A good chat is a trade. Answer your own questions after they do, and react to what they say rather than waiting for your turn.

If the conversation is dull, uncomfortable or disrespectful, you can press Next at any time. A short “nice meeting you, take care” is polite, but you do not owe anyone an explanation. Report anyone who breaks the rules.

sections.h: Keep in touch with people you like
p: When you click with someone, add them as a friend. With a free account you can message them and call them again later, so a lucky chat can turn into a real friendship.

title: How Random Video Chat Works: Matching, Privacy and Moderation
description: What happens when you press Start: how people are matched, how video is delivered, what is stored and how moderation works.
intro: Random video chat looks simple from the outside: you press a button and someone appears. Here is what happens behind that button, and what it means for your privacy.

sections.h: Step 1: you join a waiting pool
p: When you press Start, you join a pool of people who are waiting to chat. If you use filters, such as a country or gender with Premium, the system looks for someone who fits. If nobody matches for a while, the filters are relaxed so you are not left waiting.
Two people from the pool are matched and both are told to connect. Matching is automatic and nobody chooses who they get, which is what makes it random.
Video and audio travel through a media server. This is designed to work across different networks and firewalls. On Wavely, video is not stored on that server.

sections.h: Step 4: you talk, or press Next
p: You can talk, type in the text chat next to the video, or press Next to be paired with someone else. Either person can leave at any time.
Several layers work together:
ul: Everyone must confirm they are 18 or older and accept the chat rules.
Your device can check the other person's video and hide it if it looks explicit.
A Report button sends moderators a screenshot and the recent chat lines.
Repeat offenders are banned, including by device.

p: Normal calls are not recorded. When someone reports a call, a screenshot and the recent chat lines are saved for moderators to review and are deleted after a retention period. Accounts store the details you give them, such as an email address and display name.
You can try Wavely without signing up. Creating a free account lets you add friends, message them and keep your history. Premium removes daily limits and adds filters.
